newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Hershey taps banks for $600 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Hershey taps banks for $600 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Nov 18 (LPC) - Citicorp's Citbank and BankAmerica Corp are in the syndicated loan market with a $600 million bank loan that refinances existing debt of Hershey Foods Corp banking sources said.
The deal replaces a credit of identical size and structure put in place in December 1995 by the two banks, though with slightly reduced pricing, bankers said.
The loan is split between a $200 million, 364-day facility and a $400 million, five-year revolver.
Pricing on the shorter tranche is 14 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR), plus a 3.5 basis-point annual fee, according to a lender.
The longer portion is priced at 12 basis points over LIBOR, plus a 5.5 basis-point annual fee, the lender added.
